title: Noah Builds the Ark
lesson: Obey God even when everyone laughs.
lines: The world had become violent and wicked. But one man still walked with God: Noah.
God told Noah: Build an ark. A huge boat. A flood is coming.
It had to be 300 cubits long. That's longer than a football pitch. In the middle of dry land.
The neighbours laughed. Hey Noah! Expecting rain? It hasn't rained in forever!
Noah kept hammering. Day after day. Month after month. Year after year.
He didn't argue. He didn't quit. He just did everything God commanded him.
When God asks you to do something, do it, even if the whole world is laughing. Because one day, nobody will be laughing.
Next time: two by two, the animals arrive. Follow so you don't miss it!
